cageDefinition.tubeCell: two ordered source sections plus closed ring fan; each triangular prism split into three tetrahedra
cageDefinition.nativeFrames: per digit segment proper frame; section radii retained from source

limitations: Only per-digit section tube cells are covered; forefoot/metatarsal/heel/web branch volume is not yet represented by this cage.
Positive sampled cell Jacobians do not prove global injectivity.
No candidate GLB or learner acceptance is produced by this inspection tool.
